PASS-WITH-NOTES — static performance/283, exact head e38a9be31ec4076c3204c7c8de607d9beb978ef9.

No blocking performance finding. Seven-file delta against parent 46106685eee34a73cb26223d05cb2199c40b715b reviewed; HEAD matched. No builds, tests, live measurements or daemon changes for this verdict.

[INFERENCE] MAX_HOPS=16 bounds predecessor discovery to K<=16 earlier boundaries on the same launch PER NEW /clear; it is not a lifetime cap on that launch. Repeated clears can revisit completed predecessors. Discovery is one registry get and one full roster read, then at most 16 in-memory roster scans: O(16*R) for R roster rows, O(R) roster storage, at most 16 pairs.

The task runs K predecessor redos plus the current carry: <=17 carry calls, not 17 concurrent tasks. A predecessor without an intent costs one spine lookup; one with a valid intent costs two, not one. Completed intents still validate their forward chain before the already-done return. Earlier-only bounds are <=32 spine lookups and <=272 root/forward registry gets; including discovery/current intent and chain checks, conservative bounds are one roster read, <=34 spine lookups and <=290 registry gets. These exclude normal writer/mail/drain internals.

No new RECURRING loop, poller, timer site or process launch site. New bounded predecessor, carry-batch and holder-hop loops do exist inside the existing clear-triggered task. Discovery is bypassed for Start::Redo at boot/registration; holder repair also applies to those existing redos. If no clear/redo runs, incremental steady-state work is zero. At clear rate lambda, batch work scales with <=17*lambda carry attempts/s, not with seats per tick.

Git remains per PROJECT/PER CARRY, not per hop: carry_project invokes the existing commit once outside the holder traversal. A batch can offer sum(P_i) such commits for its unfinished carries, <=17P if each has P projects. No-op copies create no commit. Existing writer subprocess work can therefore increase during recovery: no new launch site is not globally launch-free. Drains are deduplicated by live endpoint: normally one stable end, <=17 under changing ends.

via holds <=15 retired seats; holder traversal is <=16 scans per scoped key, O(16*(H+15)) for H holder rows, and adds ended-row insert attempts inside the existing ONE index transaction. The existing settle loop can repeat per unfinished carry: <=19 sleeps x250ms each; conservative batch sleep budget <=80.75s, NOT a wall-time bound because locks/I/O are separate. No new sleep implementation.

Cost wording should state one OR two spine lookups per predecessor and include full redo work, not just discovery. References: carry.rs:73-114,169-205,221-256,280-301,345-357,450-531; community/directory.rs:2257-2435; store/community.rs:255-299. Correctness/security disposition remains with their holders.
